title: Unforgiving
description: Unforgiving is a brutal hardcore survival modpack where thirst, temperature, smarter mobs, and realistic damage systems will kill you repeatedly.
body:
Every breath could be your last.

Unforgiving strips away the safety net of vanilla Minecraft and replaces it with brutal realism. Thirst will drain you. Temperature will freeze or burn you. Hunger is relentless. Monsters are smarter, faster, and hunt in packs. Death has consequences.

This isn't a game anymore—it's a fight for survival.

🔥 Features:
- Realistic temperature & thirst systems
- Smarter, deadlier mobs with enhanced AI
- Seasonal weather that affects gameplay
- Punishing food system (no spam-eating bread)
- Hardcore death mechanics
⚠️ WARNING: This pack is NOT for casual players. Expect to die. A lot.

Can you survive the first night? Prove it.
